page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Hebrew dictionary entries. Running head centred at top, page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: נגב m. Auster, Meridies, Tractus meridianus, Plaga australis, 1.Sam.27.10. נגבה Ad plagam australem, In meridianum tractum, Gen.13.1. R. Bechai scribit: נגב vocatur, שאותו רוח נגוב ויבש quòd iste ventus sit siccus & aridus, propter intensum calorem solis: נגב Aridum esse, Exarescere, in Targum & apud Rabb. Vide & Ab. Efram, Gen.12.9.

נגד Coram, Contra, Ante, E regione, Ex adverso: לנגד Coram, 2.Reg.1.13. Ex adversò, Contra, Pro-verb.21.30. מנגד E regione, Gen.21.16. Ex adverso, 2.Sam.18.13. נגדה Coram, Psal.116.14. Cum Aff. נגדו Ex adver-so sui, Jos.6.5. Coram eo, Jesa.40.17. כנגדו Secundum coram ipsum, Quasi juxta correspondentiam ejus, Ipsi tanquam alter-ipse, ac naturali specie ac forma conveniens, Astans ei, Gen.2.8. לנגדו Ex adverso ejus, Jos.5.13. Chald. נגד Ex adverso, Dan.6.11.
נגר Chald. Traxit se, Manavit, Profluxit: Inde Partic. נגד Trahens se, manans, Dan.7.10.

הגיד Hiph. Nunciavit, Annunciavit, Renunciavit, Indicavit, Expoluit, Narravit, Enarravit, Retulit; nempe Coram: Praeter. הגיד לו Indicavit ei, Genes.31.20. Hoph. Praeter. הגד Nunciatum est, 1.Sam.23.13. Infin. הגד Nunciando, Jos.9.24. Futur. ויגד Et nunciatum est, Gen.22.20.

נגיד m. Antecessor, Antistes, Dux, Praesul, Princeps, 2.Sam.7.8. Constr. נגיד עמי Ducem populi mei, 2.Reg.20. v.5. Plural. נגידים אדבר Antecessorum seu principum, scil. verba, eloquar, hoc est, Praestantia, principibus digna, quasi Principalia dicā, Prov.8.6. cui similem locutionem vide Proverb.22.20.
נגה Splenduit, Jes.9.2. Fut. יגה Splendebit, Job.18.5. Hiph. Futurum, יגיר אור Splendescere faciet, Splendi-

page.notes: Hebrew readings are copied as seen, with vowel points only where printed. The Hebrew in the third line of the first entry, and the Hebrew for "Fut." in the last entry, are doubtful and could not be verified letter by letter. Printing errors such as "Praefusl" were not present; "Praesul" was read as printed. The word "dicā" carries a macron that may be a damaged mark.
